thread:
talia: Hi team :wave: I’m Talia, starting today on Platform. Quick blockers for my first-week infra setup — I don’t have access to the eu GCP project (europe-west4) and I can’t see the billing account link in the console. Also need to assume an AWS role for cross-account dev access (we use a devops-prod account setup). Who should I ping for both?

devon: welcome! :tada: You should file the cloud-access form but I can triage now. Which GCP project ID do you need access to? Also what AWS role ARN do you expect?

talia: Project is redwood-dev-eu, need Viewer + Service Account Token Creator on a couple of service accounts so I can run local tests. AWS role is arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-developer (tried sts:AssumeRole and got AccessDenied).

maria: adding some quick checks — for GCP if you’re hitting a 403 on europe-west4 that’s usually either org policy blocking region or folder-level permissions. Can you paste the exact error (screenshot or full message)?

talia: paste of gcloud output: ```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) Some requests did not succeed:
 - code: 403, message: Access denied.
```

carlos: +1 to org policy possibility. infra-bot, can you run a policy lookup for project redwood-dev-eu and region europe-west4?

infra-bot: @carlos requested org policy check for project redwood-dev-eu. Results: Restriction 'constraints/compute.restrictLocations' present on folder /org/12345/folders/67. Allowed locations: europe-west1,europe-west2. europe-west4 is blocked.

devon: ok that explains GCP region 403. Talia — options: (1) request a folder-level exception (takes ~3-5 business days), (2) use an allowed europe-west2 dev project we can quickly create for you, or (3) request that your workload be run in europe-west1/2 if latency/region not strict. Which works?

talia: I need kms in eu-west4 specifically for a partner integration (data residency). If exception is required, who owns the policy request?

maria: Policy exceptions are handled by Compliance + Infra. I can kick off the request — need a short justification + list of resources. If you DM me the partner name and why eu-west4 is required I’ll start the approval. Meanwhile I can create a temporary project in europe-west2 so you can start dev work.

talia: thanks — DMing details now.

carlos: on AWS role: I checked the trust policy for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-developer and it looks fine but you might be missing sts:AssumeRole on your user policy. Talia, run: ```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-developer --role-session-name talia-session
```
Include the error if it fails.

talia: ran the command, error: `AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::210987654321:user/talia is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole on resource arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-developer`

devon: that means your AWS IAM principal doesn’t have the assumeRole permission in the source account. Carlos, can you add a temporary inline policy to talia with sts:AssumeRole for that role?

carlos: I’ll add a scoped policy for just that role and send you a confirmation here.

infra-bot: Carlos updated IAM policy for user talia: added policy with action sts:AssumeRole on resource arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-developer (expires 72h).

talia: trying again... success! Got temporary creds and assumed role. Thanks 🙏

maria: filed the org policy exception ticket (INC-2026-045). I attached your justification and flagged it as priority due to partner SLA. I’ll update this thread when we get approval — ETA ~2 business days.

devon: notes for onboarding doc: add a troubleshooting section for 403 on specific regions (org policy) and a checklist for assume-role failures (check user policy, trust policy, temporary remedies). I’ll put a PR up in devex onboarding repo.

talia: this is super helpful, appreciate the fast responses. One last Q — who owns adding billing link to a new project? I don’t see Billing > Account in console for redwood-dev-eu.

maria: Billing access is handled by Finance ops. I’ll ping finance-ops and include the billing-account id they should link. (@finance-ops will you enable billing for project redwood-dev-eu: billing-account BA-98765?)

devon: tagging finance-ops in case they don’t see this: @finance-ops — helping a new hire link billing for redwood-dev-eu (project). Thanks! :pray:

infra-bot: finance-ops notified about billing link request via ticket FIN-2026-312.

talia: thanks everyone — I can proceed with dev in europe-west2 for now and will wait on exception + billing. :raised_hands:
